structured.approach: I read feat.tasks to find the Backend tasks: TSK-05 and TSK-06, both in ap_aging. I used the permission-table tool view (tool:repo-access), because org.permission_table is restricted and passed by reference only. To check the "no secrets" entry against the code, I searched the ap_aging checkout for environment, credential and network-import patterns. I also read aging.py, ci.py, CLAUDE.md and .git/config. There were no matches. Both tasks are pure functions with no transport, so no secret is needed or granted and I raised no access request. I did not use the connectors (osv, pypi, codegraph) or the verifier: the inputs held all the facts, and the output makes only a few statements.

claims.text: No secrets are required for ap_aging and none are granted (permission table).
The Backend tasks are TSK-05 (STORY-05) and TSK-06 (STORY-06), both in ap_aging.
TSK-05 adds the pure function overdue_with_risk(invoices, as_of, risk_by_vendor). TSK-06 adds overdue_rows_to_json(rows) and must not add a transport layer, because one would re-trigger DES-01.
aging.py imports only datetime, decimal and typing, and has no network, file or environment access.
CI runs locally with the standard library plus coverage. SonarQube is not available locally, so no credential is needed.
The repository's language is Python 3.9 (standard library).
The LLM provider (acme-llm) is touched only by TSK-04 in ap_forecast. The Backend lane receives the vendor risk as the risk_by_vendor argument.

structured.summary: I wrote task.secrets_scope.md for FEAT-ZD-48600. The Backend tasks (TSK-05 and TSK-06 in ap_aging) need no secrets in any environment, and none are granted, so no access request was raised. This matches the permission table and the code: aging.py is pure standard-library code, CI needs no credential, and the tasks forbid a transport layer. The acme-llm credential belongs to the Data Science lane (TSK-04) and git credentials belong to BE-01, so both are out of scope. If a transport, a database or an external call is added later, this step must run again. Nothing blocks this step.
